items.title: Tony Fougerat Interview, 1960-06-08
items.q: him and Lester and Harry Shields, it was the team up. Three of them played in the same joint at the same time. And the Vanity Club down on Boybin and, uh, Bienville. And, uh, I, I happened to be playing in that band too.

ctx.x: I don't know. I think in his late forties. And Lester's, Lester's been about in his middle fifties now. And, uh, him and, uh, was another good clarinet player. I was talking to him yesterday. These two boys used to team up. One time, three of them teamed up together. And, uh, with a boy named Jack Marano. Very good clarinet and, and sax man. And, uh, him and Lester and Harry Shields, it was the team up. Three of them played in the same joint at the same time. And the Vanity Club down on Boybin and, uh, Bienville.…
And, uh, which Angelo is this? The guitar player?
